svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Triad Drift HUD - space combat (alert)
svg.text: 5% safe margin (96 px / 54 px) - guide only, not drawn in game
Shield arc empty (track only); hull arc amber below 50%, red below 25%
Heat arc appears at 60%; red + HOT at 90%
Power on cooldown: grey ring refills clockwise, glyph dims
Unlocked ability pip 28 px (hidden until unlocked)
LOCK diamond + tag on the bracket; other locks = amber diamonds
Missile warning 150x28 above reticle + red edge chevron toward it (pulses 2.5 Hz when imminent)
Hit direction arc r150, 50 deg: red = hull, pale blue = shield only; fades in 1.2 s
Wingman in trouble (hull < 35%): amber outline pulses 1 Hz + ! badge
Active chip (Bastion) shows name; same order, never reshuffles
Boost bar 160x6: shows while boosting / refilling, hides 1.5 s after full
Lower lane (one message at a time): hyperdrive block > interact > hint
Low hull: 10% red edge vignette (not counted as coverage)
